$description: Taitube design tokens, W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. ref: raw ramps. set: swappable implementations per group (typography, fontSize, spacing, sizing, radius, border, shadow, ambient, motion). theme: colour roles per mode, dataviz, and the default implementation of every set. scale: fixed scales no theme changes. Ticket 95 turns this file into @vp/design-tokens and @vp/ui.

live.$description: Live and recording only. Never an accent, never decoration.

set.$description: Swappable token sets. A theme names one implementation per group as its default; the viewer may override any group at runtime. Each implementation ships as @vp/ui/tokens/<group>/<implementation>.

typography.$description: Font families, weights and tracking per type style. Fonts are imported by the set that uses them.

figtree.$description: Warm, friendly UI face. Sand's default.

geist.$description: Precise, technical UI face. Nocturne's default.

system.$description: The platform's own faces: no font download at all.

fontSize.$description: Size and line height per type style. The accessibility control the viewer reaches first.

small.$description: One step down: denser text for large screens.

display.$description: Hero titles, channel names on the channel page.

headline.$description: Page titles, the watch page title on large screens.

title.$description: Card titles, two lines at most.

overline.$description: Uppercase eyebrows: the channel byline on cards, section kickers.

editorial.$description: Curator notes, the Pick of the day blurb, channel manifestos. Never UI chrome.

mono.$description: Durations, timestamps, counts that line up. Always tabular-nums.

spacing.$description: Semantic spacing roles over the 4px scale. Choosing compact here is what the simple Density control does.

sizing.$description: Component and layout sizes. control and icon keys (sm, md, lg) are the ControlSize and IconSize unions; avatar keys (xs to xl) are SizeOption. The touch target never drops below 44px.

radius.$description: Corner radius per role. Keys are the RadiusOption union.

shadow.$description: Elevation steps 1 to 3 per mode family (dark covers OLED).

flat.$description: No shadows: surfaces separate by borders and steps of ground only.

deep.$description: Pronounced depth for a more physical feel.

ambient.$description: The glow sampled from video behind the stage, the Pick of the day and the channel banner.

motion.$description: Durations and easings. prefers-reduced-motion forces reduced whatever is chosen.

calm.$description: Slower and gentler for viewers who find motion busy.

reduced.$description: Opacity only: every move is a cross-fade, and short.

sand.$description: Default theme. Warm taupe ground, brass accent; starts round, soft-shadowed and cinematic.

defaults.$description: The implementation of each token set this theme starts from; one line each to change.

raised.$description: Menus, popovers, toasts, hover on a surface.

border-strong.$description: Field and control outlines, hovered dividers. 3:1 on bg.

tint.$description: Translucent fill: secondary button, hover, skeleton base.

tint-strong.$description: Pressed, selected chip ground, skeleton highlight.

accent.$description: Primary action fill, progress, selection. Never status.

accent-ink.$description: Accent as text: links, active labels.

accent-soft.$description: Selected nav item, soft badge ground.

scrim.$description: Behind dialogs and sheets; under text on video.

media.$description: Letterbox behind video. Same in every mode.

accent.$description: Darker step: ochre-500 is 2:1 on paper.

accent-ink.$description: ochre-700 is 4.3:1 on accent-soft, so text takes the 800 step.

oled.$description: Dark with a true-black ground; every role not listed inherits from dark.

nocturne.$description: Secondary theme. Blue-ink ground, marquee amber accent; starts sharp, flat and subtle.

defaults.$description: The implementation of each token set this theme starts from; one line each to change.

warning-ink.$description: Coral, not amber: amber is the accent here, so warning always carries its icon too.

accent-hover.$description: Lighter, not darker: on-accent is dark ink here.

accent-ink.$description: amber-700 is 3.6:1 on ink-50, so text takes the 800 step.

oled.$description: Dark with a true-black ground; every role not listed inherits from dark.

space.$description: The raw 4px scale. Components use spacing roles from the spacing set; this scale is for one-off layout.
